contracts.cleanup: Owned actors settle closed only after native close. Spawn errors retain the original Error diagnostic; registered cleanup awaits all settled actor outcomes before removing fixtures. Every kill checks for a defined owned child PID. The shared cleanup is registered directly with afterEach; its framework invocation is inspected, not a test of Vitest.
contracts.backstops: Public beforeEach TestContext.task.timeout supplies the resolved outer timeout to parent barrier, child pause budget and spawn watchdog. Their windows begin during the test, so none expires before its outer timeout. Zero-budget contract asserts exit/error outcomes without elapsed thresholds.
